purpose: Prospective component-method selection on five disjoint disease partitions of TRANSCRIPT

methods.B0p: Training-fold positive association count per drug
methods.B1k: Training-fold label propagation from expression-similar drugs with 10 neighbors
methods.B1: Label-free negative Spearman correlation between drug and disease expression
methods.B2: Fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of B0p, B1k and B1 with k=60

disclosure: Partitions are new evaluation units but derive from the already studied TRANSCRIPT dataset; this is not an independent external-dataset validation. No test metrics or outcome labels may enter the model prompt.
